content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: NIEPMD(D) is located at Muttukadu, East Coast Road, Kovalam (P.O), Chennai - 603 112, Tamil Nadu, and functions under the Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Its letterhead mentions NAAC accreditation and ISO 9001:2015. The posts are at CDEIC, NIEPMD(D) Chennai and at CRC Madurai.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The posts total 22 as the notice's counts add up: 15 at NIEPMD(D) Chennai and 7 at CRC Madurai. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Online applications are invited from eligible Indian Nationals. The maximum age is 56 years for all positions except Sl. No. 11 (need-based visits, which has no age limit), reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation and no minimum age. The same qualifications apply to the CRC Madurai posts of Occupational Therapist, ASLP, Special Educator (both types), Early Interventionist, Physiotherapist and Nurse. For the need-based visits post, the notice lists these qualifications by profession: Medical Doctors: MBBS with PG Degree/PG Diploma in the requisite specialization or equivalent. Genetic Counsellor: Master's degree in Genetic Counselling/Medical Genetics or equivalent. Optometrist: Bachelor of Optometry (B.Optom)/Doctor of Optometry or equivalent. Nutritionist/Dietitian: M.Sc. in Nutrition/Food & Nutrition/Clinical Nutrition or B.Sc. Dietetics with relevant registration/certification, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary. The term ordinarily does not exceed an initial 3 years and may be extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. Only a consolidated honorarium is paid; allowances such as DA, HRA, MA, GPF and NPS are not admissible. The pay rules and service terms are below. Need-based visits post: a total of max. 15 visits of medical or allied health professionals in a month, with at least 4 hours per visit. Medical Professionals with MBBS/PG receive Rs. 3750/- per visit; allied health professionals receive Rs. 3000/- per visit. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. An annual increment of 5% is based on completion of one year from the date of joining and a satisfactory performance report evaluated by the department. The incumbent has no right to claim regularization or extension/renewal of engagement in any circumstances. The competent authority can terminate the engagement at any time without assigning reasons by giving 30 days notice. A consultant who wishes to resign must give 30 days advance notice or remuneration in lieu.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts total 22: 15 at NIEPMD(D) Chennai and 7 at CRC Madurai. They cover Clinical Psychologist, Occupational Therapist, ASLP, Early Interventionist, Special Educator, Physiotherapist, Nurse, Trained Caregivers, Activity Teacher, need-based visits, Social Worker and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is within 21 days from the date of publishing the advertisement in Employment News. The notice, dated 06-11-2026, does not print a calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NIEPMD consultant posts?
faq.answer: It varies by post. For example, a Nurse needs a Diploma in Nursing and a Physiotherapist needs BPT, each with a minimum of 2 years' relevant post-qualification experience. A Data Entry Operator needs a graduate degree with knowledge of computer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years for all positions except Sl. No. 11, the need-based visits post, which has no age limit. Age is reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.590/- (including GST), payable through RTGS/NEFT/IMPS. SC/ST/PWDs/Female/Transgender candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of NIEPMD consultants?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is 60000 for Clinical Psychologist / Rehabilitation Psychologist, 50000 for therapist, educator and Physiotherapist posts, 42000 for Nurse, Activity Teacher and Social Worker, 30000 for Trained Caregivers and 25000 for Data Entry Operator. The need-based visits post is paid Rs. 3750 or Rs. 3000 per visit.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only, using the link on https://niepmd.nic.in/notice-category/recruitments./ Pay the fee through RTGS/NEFT/IMPS unless exempted, and attach the requisite documents. Applications without them are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post at NIEPMD?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate who wishes to apply for more than one discipline or post must submit a separate online application form along with proof of requisite fees for each.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIEPMD consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary on contract, ordinarily for an initial period not exceeding 3 years and extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. The incumbent has no right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q10. Are HRA and other allowances paid with the NIEPMD remuneration?
faq.answer: No. Only a consolidated honorarium is paid; DA, HRA, MA, GPF, NPS and other allowances are not admissible.
